title: nectandra dominicana
intro: Nectandra dominicana, commonly known as Dominican boxwood or Dominican box, is a plant species belonging to the family Lauraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents present in Nectandra dominicana include limonoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, anti-infection, and anti-aging properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a promising natural remedy for various health issues.
